title: Chuang Tzu, Mystic, Moralist and Social Reformer
author: Chuang Tzu (Giles trans)
description: Herbert Giles presents the thought of Chuang Tzu through stories, paradoxes and reflections on naturalness. The work explores freedom from rigid distinctions and the possibility of living in accordance with the Tao.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/chuangtzumysticm00chua).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
